before: A format, indent, list, deletion, or typing over a range that ended on a page still being laid out, or in a paragraph hidden whole, did nothing and reported nothing.
after: The write finishes any pending layout first and applies to the whole range. A range that ends in text the page does not show is refused locally with a named reason, and nothing is sent to the room.
reason: The written operations are the ones the same command already writes for a laid-out range. A refused write sends nothing. No shared state, update, or room rule changes.
